tweetText: The EU has released its AI content labelling playbook to help companies comply with new transparency rules starting August 2. This initiative aims to ensure accountability and trust in the use of generative AI across the bloc. via AI News
AI red teaming is crucial for testing systems under tough conditions to find weaknesses before they’re used. This helps organizations enhance safety and reliability in AI deployment. via AI News

AI-powered CMS platforms are changing how businesses manage content by streamlining processes and improving coordination. This shift enhances efficiency and effectiveness in reaching diverse markets and contributors. via AI News.

Huawei announced HarmonyOS 7, seizing the opportunity left by Apple’s Siri not launching in China. This move could strengthen Huawei's position in the AI market and offer a localized alternative for users. via AI News

Malaysia's Respond.io raised $62.5M to enhance its AI agent-powered messaging app and plans acquisitions. This funding helps the startup scale its innovative approach to customer support, charging by conversation instead of seats. via TechCrunch AI

Sundar Pichai got booed and faced a walkout at Stanford's graduation due to Google's ties with Israel and ICE. This highlights ongoing concerns about tech companies' roles in controversial defense contracts. via TechCrunch AI

The US government forced Anthropic to pull its new cybersecurity models, showing they can intervene in the AI industry. This highlights ongoing tensions between tech innovation and government regulation. via TechCrunch AI

Meta is launching a new 'AI Mode' on Facebook that uses public info from its platforms to enhance user engagement. This move shows Meta's commitment to staying competitive in the fast-evolving AI landscape. via TechCrunch AI

Cybersecurity experts are pushing the White House to lift export bans on Anthropic's Fable and Mythos AI models. They believe these restrictions hinder defenders' ability to protect software and products. via TechCrunch AI
Salesforce just acquired AI customer service platform Fin for $3.6B to enhance its Agentforce offering. This move aims to boost automation in customer service for businesses. via TechCrunch AI
